children: An index tracking emerging-market currencies climbed to a session high after weaker-than-expected US jobs data led traders to scale back bets on another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month, according to Bloomberg.

Nonfarm payrolls rose by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday showed. The figure missed all estimates in a Bloomberg survey of economists.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Emerging-Market Currencies Rise After Weak US Jobs Data
